name: Collateral Value 5
definition: Provides details of the collateral reference data.

SecurityIdentification.name: Security Identification
SecurityIdentification.definition: Identification of a security by an ISIN.

ValuationCurrency.name: Valuation Currency
ValuationCurrency.definition: Provides details of the currency of the valuation.

ValuationPrice.name: Valuation Price
ValuationPrice.definition: Provides details of the price provided for the security.

ValuationCloseLinkPrice.name: Valuation Close Link Price
ValuationCloseLinkPrice.definition: Price of the security as of the valuation date in the collateral valuation currency where there is a close link between the credit consumer and the security provided as collateral.

AccruedInterest.name: Accrued Interest
AccruedInterest.definition: Amount of money or rate accrued interest computed in the case of interest bearing financial instruments.

Haircut.name: Haircut
Haircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the security expressed as a percentage.

CloseLinkHaircut.name: Close Link Haircut
CloseLinkHaircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the security expressed as a percentage in case of close links.

PoolFactor.name: Pool Factor
PoolFactor.definition: Percentage that applies to price of the securities following a redemption.

ForeignExchange.name: Foreign Exchange
ForeignExchange.definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.
